properties.name: GSI NLSM: Joshimath Severe Landslide Susceptibility Zone
properties.description: High susceptibility terrain comprised of fractured gneiss and old landslide debris with high seepage pressures.

properties.name: GSI NLSM: Helang - Gulabkoti Moderate Susceptibility Corridor
properties.source: GSI BhuKosh / National Landslide Susceptibility Mapping
properties.description: Moderate susceptibility slope along steep riverward escarpment prone to road-cut toe erosion.

properties.name: GSI BhuKosh: Main Central Thrust (MCT) Seismic-Fault Shear Zone
properties.source: GSI BhuKosh Geological Map of India
properties.description: Major tectonic boundary between Lesser and Higher Himalayas; acts as regional weakness plane triggering secondary mass movements.
